listing.name: Puyo Puyo Box (PuyoPuyoBoxRecomp)
listing.summary: Attach an independently permitted, prepared Puyo Puyo Box PlayStation Windows runtime after upstream Generate & Build completes. Keep the exact Japan CUE/BIN, completed build-release product, cards and complete setup tree; scaffold text does not establish gameplay maturity.

steps.title: Prepare the exact Japan PlayStation disc
steps.instruction: Use a complete player/components you are independently permitted to use, with your own Puyo Puyo Box Japan SLPS-03114 CUE and all referenced BIN tracks. The selected profile pins data Track 01 to 141,853,824 bytes and SHA1 ca01a98ccc5ca796df082782a6dd1adee856c064, boot executable SLPS_031.14. This is a track fingerprint, not a signature for any renamed image or another release. Replace the upstream author’s example absolute path with your own actual source in its setup UI; this guide accesses no such example path. Keep independent originals.

steps.title: Complete the standalone setup flow upstream
steps.instruction: The inspected official v.0.1.1 Windows ZIP contains AMD64 PuyoPuyoBox_Recomp.exe as the preparation host with SDK/project resources and OpenBIOS. It is not proof of a finished gameplay executable. Complete the built-in Generate & Build flow first. The selected codegen_setup.c names build-release/ and completed PuyoPuyoBox_Recompiled as its product, with generation marker SLPS_031.14_dispatch.c; setup/rebuild can quit and relaunch through a helper. Bundled OpenBIOS is the supported no-Sony-BIOS route; an independently permitted personal SCPH BIOS is separate. No disc, BIOS, helper, toolchain, compiler or game is obtained or executed here.

steps.title: Attach only the completed native product
steps.instruction: After upstream reports the build complete, select the actual build-release/PuyoPuyoBox_Recompiled.exe in the completed upstream product, use that complete build-release directory with its staged resources as working directory and set the runtime’s documented --no-launcher argument. Review the exact intent and request Play separately. The actual generated runtime main handles the integrated launcher and game in process. Do not attach the first-run setup host or RetComM hub and assume it represents the finished player. If the named native product is absent or generation/rebuild is still needed, finish upstream preparation before attachment; do not substitute a guessed executable.

steps.title: Keep setup, product and actual card paths
steps.instruction: Retain the complete upstream setup/project tree and build-release product, generated source/build metadata, staged game.toml/game_options.toml, settings.toml, bios/, disc files, mods/ and actual saves/memory-card paths. Source/runtime defaults use saves/, but existing per-slot/external card settings remain authoritative. Keep every previous product root and original CUE/BIN; rebuilds can replace the native program and restage support data. Cards, save states, netplay track/TOC identity and four-player settings have separate compatibility scope. This guide performs no import, conversion, backup, restore, migration or deletion.

steps.title: Retain exact component scope and honest maturity
steps.instruction: The authoritative gitlinks are psxrecomp 17f49ad3b20dc30917a881a02baaa25374c13d18 (PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0) and recomp-ui 655d77d5858aa677f88e7b19cd70460773a17476 (MIT), with OpenBIOS and other component notices retained. They do not license the original Compile/Sega game, proprietary BIOS or optional artwork/mods. RetComM is a separate optional manager, not Portcove-owned runtime replacement. Quit normally before upstream rebuild/update or card changes, preserve recovery and review/relink changed bytes. The title README remains scaffolded: no working gameplay, full campaign, native/installed, four-player, real-save, netplay or Supported observation is asserted. Registration removal preserves external files; managed lifecycle operations remain unavailable.

warnings: Complete Generate & Build before selecting the actual build-release native product. The inspected download is the setup host; gameplay maturity and all native observations remain Unknown.
